procedures.heading: Accessing Trouble Codes
steps: Ensure engine is at normal operating temperature.
Switch ignition OFF.
Jump test connector (green 1 pin) to ground Image 1 [1]
Switch ignition ON.
Count MIL flashes and compare with trouble code table
1.2 second flashes indicate the ‘tens’ of the trouble code Image 2 [A]
0.4 second flashes indicate the ‘units’ of the trouble code Image 2 [D]
A 1.6 second pause (MIL OFF) separates ‘TENS’ and ‘UNITS’ Image 2[C]
A 0.4 second pause (MIL OFF) separates each flash Image 2 [B]
A 4 second pause separates each trouble code Image 2 [E]
For example: Trouble code 22 displayed Image 2

procedures.heading: Clearing Trouble Codes
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF
Disconnect battery ground lead
Depress the brake pedal for a minimum of 5 seconds
Reconnect battery ground lead
Jump test connector (Green 1 pin) to ground Image 1 [1]
Switch ignition ON
Wait 6 seconds
Start engine
Allow engine to reach normal operating tempertature
Run engine at 2000 rpm for 2 minutes
Allow to idle
Check MIL for further trouble codes
Switch ignition OFF
Remove jump lead
Repeat checking procedure to ensure no data remains in ECM fault memory

title: Mazda OBD/OBD2 Codes >> Mazda 94-95 MPV & 92-95 MX-3 & 90-95 MX-5 Miata & 90-94 Protege & 91-94 323

procedures.heading: Accessing Trouble Codes
steps: Trouble codes can be displayed with an LED test lamp or accessed with a suitable code reader connected to the data link connector (DLC) Image 1
Switch ignition OFF.
Connect LED tester between data link connector (DLC) terminal FEN and battery (12 volt) positive Image 2
Jump DLC terminals TEN and GND Image 2
Switch ignition ON.
Count LED flashes and compare with trouble code table
1.2 second flashes indicate the ‘tens’ of the trouble code Image 3 [A]
0.4 second flashes indicate the ‘units’ of the trouble code Image 3 [D]
A 1.6 second pause (MIL OFF) separates ‘TENS’ and ‘UNITS’ Image 3[C]
A 0.4 second pause (MIL OFF) separates each flash Image 3 [B]
A 4 second pause separates each trouble code Image 3 [E]
For example: Trouble code 22 displayed Image 3

procedures.heading: Clearing Trouble Codes
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF
Disconnect battery ground lead
Depress the brake pedal for a minimum of 5 seconds
Reconnect battery ground lead
Connect LED tester between DLC terminal FEN and battery (12 volt) positive Image 2
Jump DLC terminal TEN and GND Image 2
Switch ignition ON. Do not start engine.
Wait 6 seconds
Start engine
Allow engine to reach normal operating tempertature
Run engine at 2000 rpm for 3 minutes
Check that no trouble codes are displayed
Switch ignition OFF
Remove jump lead and LED tester

title: Mazda OBD/OBD2 Codes >> 94 Mazda B2300 or B3000 or B4000 or Navajo 4.0L

procedures.heading: Accessing Trouble Codes
steps: Start engine.
Ensure engine is at normal operating temperature.
Switch ignition OFF.
Wait 10 seconds.
Connect an analogue voltmeter between data link connector (DLC) terminal 4 and battery (12 volt) positive Image 1
Jump DLC 1 terminal Image 1 [1] to DLC 2 terminal 2 Image 1 [2]
Switch ignition ON.
Count voltmeter pulses and compare with trouble code table
A group of 0.5 second pulses indicate each of the 2 (1991), or 3 (1992-1994) trouble code digits Image 2 [A]
A 0.5 second pause separates each pulse Image 2 [B]
A 2 second pause separates each trouble code digit Image 2 [C]
A 4 second pause separates each trouble code Image 2 [D]
For example: Trouble code 231 displayed Image 2
When all present trouble codes have been displayed:
A 6-9 second pause, followed by a 0.5 second pulse, and another 6-9 second pause, indicate the start of the memorised trouble codes
Trouble codes are indicated in the same manner as above
NOTE: Memorised trouble codes refer to faults that have occurred in the last 80 ignition key cycles.
Count voltmeter pulses and compare with trouble code table
Switch ignition OFF
Remove jump lead and voltmeter
Start engine.
Ensure engine is at normal operating temperature.
Switch ignition OFF.
Wait 10 seconds.
Connect an analogue voltmeter between data link connector (DLC) terminal 4 and battery (12 volt) positive Image 1
Jump DLC 1 terminal Image 1 [1] to DLC 2 terminal 2 Image 1 [2]
Start engine.
After a group of 3 0.5 second pulses (ID code) are displayed:
Press and release the brake pedal
If after 6-20 seconds, a single 0.5 second pulse is displayed (dynamic response signal):
Increase engine speed sharply
NOTE: Do not depress throttle during the test without the dynamic response signal
Trouble codes are indicated in the same manner as above
Count voltmeter pulses and compare with trouble code table
Switch ignition OFF
Remove jump lead and voltmeter

procedures.heading: Clearing Trouble Codes
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF
Connect an analogue voltmeter between data link connector (DLC) terminal 4 and battery (12 volt) positive Image 1
Jump DLC 1 terminal Image 1 [1] to DLC 2 terminal 2 Image 1 [2]
Switch ignition ON
When trouble codes start to be displayed:
Disconnect the jumper lead between DLC 1 terminal to DLC 2 terminal
If system components have been replaced:
Disconnect battery ground lead for 5 minutes to erase adaptive memory from engine control module (ECM).
Switch ignition OFF
Remove the voltmeter
Repeat checking procedure to ensure no data remains in ECM fault memory

title: Mazda OBD/OBD2 Codes >> 626/MX-6 – B2300/B2500/B4000 – CX-7/CX-9 – Mazda3/5/6 – Millenia 2.3/2.5L – MPV 2.5/3.0L – MX-5 Miata – Protege 5 – RX-8 – Tribute (1995 – 2009)

procedures.heading: General information
steps: Engine control module (ECM) incorporates self-diagnosis function.
Malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) will illuminate if certain faults are recorded.
ECM operates in backup mode if sensors fail, to enable vehicle to be driven to workshop.

procedures.heading: Accessing
steps: Trouble codes can be displayed by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC) 1.

procedures.heading: Erasing
steps: After the faults have been rectified, trouble codes can be erased by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC).

title: Mazda OBD/OBD2 Codes >> 90-94 Mazda B2200 or 89-93 B2600 Pickup or 91-92 626/MX-6

procedures.heading: Accessing Trouble Codes
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF.
Jump test connector (green, 1 pin) to ground Image 1 [1]
Connect LED test lamp between data link connector (DLC) terminals 1 and 2 Image 1[2]
Switch ignition ON
Count LED flashes and compare with trouble code table
1.2 second flashes indicate the ‘tens’ of the trouble code
0.4 second flashes indicate the ‘units’ of the trouble code
A 1.6 second pause (MIL OFF) separates ‘TENS’ and ‘UNITS’
A 0.4 second pause (MIL OFF) separates each flash
A 4 second pause separates each trouble code
Start engine
Allow to idle
Check for further trouble codes
Switch ignition OFF
Remove jump lead and LED test lamp

procedures.heading: Clearing Trouble Codes
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF
Disconnect battery ground lead
Depress the brake pedal for a minimum of 5 seconds
Reconnect battery ground lead
Jump test connector (green, 1 pin) to ground Image 1 [1]
Connect LED test lamp between DLC terminals Image 1 [2]
Switch ignition ON. Do not start engine
Wait 6 seconds
Start engine
Ensure engine is at normal operating temperature
Run engine at 2000 rpm for 3 minutes
Check that no trouble codes are displayed
Switch ignition OFF
Remove jump lead and LED tester
